drafts.subject: Re: Speaking invitation - AgentConf 2026 (Oct 14-15, Berlin)
drafts.message:
Dear Elena,

Thank you so much for the kind invitation — we're thrilled that AgentConf is interested in Jac and the walker model! We'd be delighted to accept and have someone from the Jaseci team give a 30-minute talk.

The dates (Oct 14–15) work well for us, and we really appreciate that travel and accommodation are covered for speakers. I'll confirm the specific speaker from our team and share their bio and talk title with you shortly, well ahead of the conference.

If there are any additional details you need from us in the meantime — abstract, AV requirements, or anything else — please don't hesitate to ask. We're excited about the opportunity to present to the AgentConf audience.

Warm regards,
The Jaseci Team
impact@jaseci.org
